Notes
- marked.min.js and purify.min.js end with a sourceMappingURL comment; the .map files are not
  vendored (only browser devtools request them).
- htmx is configured in chat.html via <meta name="htmx-config"> with includeIndicatorStyles=false
  and allowEval=false (strict CSP: no inline styles, no eval).
